thread:
keisha: quick sync: need to finalize how golden-set versions and fingerprints are handled in the onboarding pipeline before we ship the admit gate change
omar: yes. current issue is we run goldsets that drift and we don't know which model commit they match
felix: propose we attach two pieces of metadata to every golden set: `golden_version` (semver-like) and `golden_fingerprint` (sha256 of canonicalized examples + expected outputs)
diana: fingerprinting sounds good but canonicalization matters. agree on newline normalization + sorted metadata keys + stable float formatting (6 decimal places?)
robin: for float outputs we should use a tolerance-based comparison and store a compact summary: mean_abs_diff, max_abs_diff, and a histogram snapshot URL
keisha: decision candidates: (A) require exact-match for discrete outputs + tolerant compare for floats; (B) require a per-gold-entry comparator function (js/python hook). which do we prefer?
omar: B gives flexibility but is harder to sandbox. A is simpler and probably sufficient for most goldsets
felix: could do hybrid: default A, allow opt-in B with explicit review and RBAC to upload goldsets that use custom comparators
diana: we also need to version goldsets in benchstore and make them immutable. uploads create `golden/v{n}` and we store `golden_fingerprint` + uploader + changelist link
qa-bot: note: add CI check that prevents same `golden_fingerprint` being uploaded twice under different versions (warn if duplicates)
robin: how do we expose golden selection to the onboarding request? header `X-Golden-Version: v12` or `X-Golden-Selector: latest:translation`
keisha: header + body field seems useful: header for routing, body for overrides. e.g. `X-Golden-Version: v12` and `{"golden_selector":"translation@latest"}`
omar: compatibility check rules: when model purports to be compatible with older runtime or vocab, run the goldset for both current expected version and last GA version. if both pass -> green; if only current passes -> warn; if neither -> fail gate
felix: we should compute a delta summary and store `results.delta_summary_url` pointing to a small report showing per-example diffs and aggregate stats
diana: for large goldsets we should support sampling for preflight: `X-Gold-Sample-Percent` header, default 5% for quick feedback. full goldset runs are gated and async
robin: storage: benchstore keeps artifacts under `benchstore/goldsets/v{n}/fingerprint` and `benchstore/results/{probe_id}`. results include `gold_hits` and `delta_summary_url`
keisha: fallback flow: if model fails current golden but passes fallback-model (a pinned older variant) then we mark admit=degrade and runtime routing will prefer fallback for production traffic while alerting owners
omar: need an operator action: create rollback runbook that uses `probe_id` -> `results.delta_summary_url` -> `rollback-candidate` and a CLI `redwood admit rollback --model X --to-version Y`
felix: for fingerprint collisions or suspected flaky gold entries, include `gold_entry_stability` metric computed from historical run variance and surface a `gold_unstable` tag when variance > threshold
diana: telemetry keys to add: `onboard.golden.version`, `onboard.golden.fingerprint`, `onboard.delta.mean_abs_diff`, `onboard.gold.sample_pct`, `onboard.admit.status`
qa-bot: tests: add unit test to canonicalize examples -> fingerprint, integration that uploads a goldset and verifies immutability, and e2e that runs sample preflight and checks `delta_summary_url` presence
infra-bot: infra notes: benchstore will need lifecycle policy for goldset artifacts (hot for 90d, cold after), and an RBAC role `goldset.uploader` scoped to teams\eap: small implementation detail: put `golden_fingerprint` into probe headers so routing/telemetry can correlate: `X-Golden-Fingerprint: <sha256>`
keisha: agreed. final decision: implement immutable goldset versions with canonicalized sha256 fingerprinting, default compare semantics (exact for discrete, tolerance for floats) with opt-in comparator hooks guarded by RBAC, sample header for preflight, delta summary URLs, fallback admit path to pinned model variants, storage + lifecycle + RBAC notes, and SDK/header contract examples. i'll draft RFC and include minimal curl + webhook examples
omar: please include a tiny example payload in RFC, something like:

```bash
curl -X POST https://ingest.internal/v1/onboard \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Golden-Version: v12" \n  -H "X-Golden-Fingerprint: abcd1234ef..." \n  -H "X-Gold-Sample-Percent: 5" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"summarize-lite-3b","async":true,"webhook":"https://hooks.prod/cb"}'
```

keisha: and example webhook we send on completion:

```json
{"probe_id":"b7f9-...","model":"summarize-lite-3b","status":"complete","results_url":"https://benchstore.internal/r/xyz","delta_summary_url":"https://benchstore.internal/deltas/xyz","metrics":{"mean_abs_diff":0.002,"max_abs_diff":0.12},"admit":"degrade","fallback_model":"summarize-2b"}
```

felix: nice. infra, can you add the RBAC role + benchstore lifecycle? infra-bot: will draft ASG + S3 lifecycle + role `goldset.uploader` and a small playbook for restoring old goldsets
robin: I'll add the telemetry keys to the tracing PR. keisha: tag devx + oncall in RFC when ready :thumbsup:
